description: This file defines a PHP class FilterMailingEvent within the Goteo Console Event namespace, which extends the Symfony Event class and encapsulates a mailing object and a message for mailing-related events.

classes.name: FilterMailingEvent
classes.description: A custom event class for mailing actions that contains a sender object and a message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a sender object and an optional message.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender object associated with the mailing event.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message associated with the mailing event.
